C1.rate_note: 1.7–2.9 V；装配后静置 12 h；1C 定义未写
C1.quote: The sulfur cathodes have a theoretical areal sulfur loading around 1.5 mg cm−2. All battery tests were conducted in two-electrode CR2032 coin cells at either room temperature or at 60 ◦C. Each battery used 15 μL of different electrolytes, with a Celgard 3401 membrane as the separator and lithium chip as the anodes. After assembled in the Ar-filled glove­ box, all batteries were rested for 12 h before electrochemical testing. For cycling tests, a galvanostatic discharge/charge procedure was conduct­ ed between 1.7 and 2.9 V at a constant rate of 0.05 C for all batteries by a battery testing system (Arbin BT2000).

comparisons.point: 室温充放电曲线；SL 观察至 200 圈
comparisons.author_judgement: 作者提出黏度与 SEI 的竞争解释；未独立分离两者贡献
comparisons.reason_quote: This high viscosity could be a reason for the different cycling performance observed: the sulfolane electrolyte might kineti­ cally slow down mass transfer due to its high viscosity thereby miti­ gating the polysulfide shuttle effect even without LiNO3 additive.
comparisons.note: 比较的是同温同倍率下穿梭现象；未将两个不同圈数的容量配成数值。正文称 SL 至 200 圈仍无显著穿梭，不等于容量保持率已知。
comparisons.quote: As shown in Fig. 1(A), at room temperature, Li-S battery (based on the same S8/CMK3 composite cathodes) using 1.5 M LiTFSi/DME/DOL electrolyte exhibits a noticeable “polysulfide shuttle effect” due to the lack of LiNO3. In contrast, as shown in Fig. 1(B), the Li-S battery with 1.5 M LiTFSi/SL electrolyte shows no significant “polysulfide shuttle effect” even after 200 cycles, despite not having the LiNO3 additive.

comparisons.author_judgement: 作者提出黏度与 SEI 的竞争解释；未独立分离两者贡献
comparisons.note: 两种电解液都出现穿梭；SL 较轻不代表无穿梭。第 5 圈后约 10% 过充仅为 SL 单边数值，不构造配对效应量。
comparisons.quote: Consequently, the polysulfide shuttle effect in a Li-S battery with sulfolane electrolyte without LiNO3 was less severe than in a Li-S battery with DME/DOL electrolyte without LiNO3 even at elevated temperature.

comparisons.unit: 圈（穿梭导致失效；非统一容量阈值）
comparisons.point: 60 °C 持续循环能力／穿梭导致无法循环
comparisons.author_judgement: 作者提出黏度与 SEI 的竞争解释；未独立分离两者贡献
comparisons.note: DD 从开始即无法正常循环；不能把这一文字人为转成寿命 0 圈。SL 在 35 圈后失效；未统一容量阈值，不计算寿命比。
comparisons.quote: In the case of the Li-S battery with DME/DOL electrolyte (without LiNO3), the shuttle effect is pronounced, preventing the battery from cycling from the start as shown in Fig. 1 (C). For the Li-S battery with sulfolane electrolyte (without LiNO3), the shuttle effect becomes noticeable after 5 discharge/charge cycles (with about 10 % overcharging), and the battery fails to cycle after 35 discharge/charge cycles due to the severe and notorious shuttle effect as shown in Fig. 1 (D).

comparisons.point: 60 °C 充放电曲线（含／不含 LiNO3）
comparisons.author_judgement: 作者提出黏度与 SEI 的竞争解释；未独立分离两者贡献
comparisons.note: LiTFSI 浓度与 LiNO3 同时变化，不能视为纯添加剂单因素；黏度更低但穿梭更少，反对仅用黏度解释全部现象。
comparisons.quote: For sulfolane electrolyte with LiNO3, at elevated temperature, the viscosity is lower than that of sulfolane electrolyte without LiNO3. However, the shuttle effect for Li-S battery with sulfolane electrolyte without LiNO3 was more pronounced than in those using sulfolane electrolyte with LiNO3. It is likely due to the different SEI compositions on Li metal surfaces for sulfolane electrolyte with and without LiNO3 as demonstrated by the study of SEI composition in DME/DOL electrolytes.

With the help of the LiNO3 additive, Li-S batteries cycling at elevated temperature show a minimized polysulfide shuttle effect in both electrolytes.
